_source: Catalogue row of the construction register (docs/design/v5.3-c-register.md). capacity = the French start stock's mean beds per establishment (data/units/stock/FRA.json: 371 440 beds over 2 905 establishments = 128), in the stock's own unit, beds, until Design's amendment D3 sets the sizing rule (the catalogue has one capacity for every nation: Germany's mean is 259; a game hospital is therefore a small one, and closure rules read capacity, never unit counts). STAND-IN numbers, none sourced: every figure marked below is the game's declared placeholder until the author's table of stand-ins (spec section 12). cost_eur_m: stand-in of 0.40 M EUR per bed, taken as about 3 300 EUR per square metre (the middle of the 2 800 to 3 900 EUR a square metre that the Baden-Wuerttemberg Rechnungshof compared for two children's clinics) times an assumed 120 square metres a bed; no per-bed audit figure was found in a bounded search. running_eur_m: stand-in of 0.26 M EUR per bed a year. staff: stand-in of 3 jobs a bed. build_months, overrun_odds, overrun_share, demolish_months, demolish_cost_share, band_units: the spec's stand-ins (sections 5, 7, 12) with a longer build for a hospital. figure_elasticity: +1 by the spec (more beds, more beds per 1 000). bloc_offset_per_pop_share: stand-in. DEU: the same per-bed stand-ins as FRA (a bounded search found no German per-bed audit figure), so the DEU cost is the FRA cost for the same 128-bed unit.
name: Hospital
summary: A hospital with its beds, open all year round.
